target_capability: chat tools schema streaming and provider fallback
assertions: The response routes to inference-and-endpoints and selects a model/provider before calling.
The response validates tool arguments and JSON schema rather than trusting model output.
The response handles sync and async stream chunks without assuming content is present and closes a cancelled stream.
The response uses one bounded provider fallback and does not claim universal provider support.
The response says MCP requires the mcp extra and a narrow allowlist.
The response keeps tokens out of logs and does not invoke live network inference.
